scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @expense/api" "npm run dev -w @expense/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @expense/api && npm run build -w @expense/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @expense/api && npm run lint -w @expense/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:prod -w @expense/api" "npm run start -w @expense/web"
